title: Design: Work Order Log shows Bill To changed with both customers as links
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom.
  • Have customer A, customer B and customer C.
  • Have a new open work order for this test for customer B (an Estimate is fine) that bills itself, so its Bill To reads This customer.
  • Sign in with 'View History Logs'.
  • Open the attached pictures bt-p2-15-after-work-order-log.png, bt-p2-14-before-work-order-log.png at 100% zoom beside the screen.
custom_steps:
1. Open the work order.
  2. Pick customer A as the Bill To on the customer card.
  3. Open the Work Order Log from the work order's menu.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The work order opens.

Step 2:

  • Bill To shows customer A.

Step 3:

  • The newest row reads Event "Bill To changed".
  • Its Details read "Bill To: [customer B's name] → [customer A's name]" with "Bill To:" in bold, each customer name an underlined blue link and an arrow between them.

Words in square brackets stand for the value they name, such as customer A's name exactly as it is saved.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Bill To", Confluence 1003585538, version 0.5 (6 Nov 2026, pending approval, Chris Ward), read 9 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-12289, story SV-12315 (Story 13, Work Order Log)

  • S13-R1: “Each Bill To change adds a "Bill To changed" entry on the work order or part sale log.”
  • S13-R2: “The entry shows "Bill To" with the old and new customer, each as a link.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
